```{r}
library(binaryRL)
```

```{r}
head(binaryRL::Mason_2024_Exp2)
```

## TD

```{r}
binaryRL.res <- binaryRL::run_m(
  data = binaryRL::Mason_2024_Exp2,                    
  id = 1,                       
  eta = c(0.123),  
  tau = c(0.789),
  n_params = 2,            
  n_trials = 360,            
  mode = "fit"
)

summary(binaryRL.res)
```

## RSTD

```{r}
binaryRL.res <- binaryRL::run_m(
  data = binaryRL::Mason_2024_Exp2,
  id = 1,
  n_params = 3,
  n_trials = 360,
  eta = c(0.123, 0.456),
  tau = c(0.789),            
  mode = "fit"
)

summary(binaryRL.res)
```

## Utility

```{r}
binaryRL.res <- binaryRL::run_m(
  data = binaryRL::Mason_2024_Exp2,
  id = 1,
  n_params = 3,
  n_trials = 360,
  eta = c(0.123),
  gamma = c(0.456),
  tau = c(0.789),            
  mode = "fit"
)

summary(binaryRL.res)
```
